name: inner_action_review

risk: Balanced attack; latched 4/6/8 percent drawdown stages; original high-water mark; no automatic recovery.

retraining.selection: All original candidate, calibration and adoption thresholds unchanged; selection uses inner validation only.

comparison: Compare all model bytes, all saved forecasts and choices. If every forecast and choice is identical, the complete new account matrix is also the fixed-forecast data bridge. Otherwise run all 1425 fixed-old-forecast accounts separately, then attribute reselection differences.
verification: Check frozen integrity, exact non-label input and raw parity, full label deltas, all 48 model reloads, all accounts with independent cash and execution audits, complete prior-account comparison and inner event coverage.
adoption: Verified data corrections are retained irrespective of whether historical returns improve. Switch the active research inputs only after the complete chain validates; no claim of new alpha or valid next-day advice without fresh market data.
limitations: Retrospective source repair on repeatedly researched data, not independent forward validation.
